replies.author: Petlas
replies.body:
Finally, someone realised.

Before the update all the developers of Avicus were getting complaints of how awful 1.8 PvP was. (Avicus didn't even create 1.8, guys ;p). Just like any loyal and dedicated staff, they granted our wish for the server to be 1.7 and 1.8 compatible. But it scarcely decreased the complaining, and there's barely even a single word of gratitude for the time you guys gave up to make the change happen. Now you have to go back to the drawing boards to fix the freshly implemented bugs. I think some members need to show a little more appreciation towards the fact that our developers and management try their hardest to ensure a fun and lovely experience on the server for us all.
